text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet goes to watch the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, she can't shake the feeling that Vodka's stirring performance has made her number one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A brilliant flame burns in Daiwa Scarlet's eyes. She means to take the number one spot back from Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Next up is the Shuka Sho, the last race of the Triple Tiara.
